name: UnitControlDTO
description: UnitControlDTO schema from Monitor Plan Management OpenAPI Specification

controlCode.description: Codes used to identify the type of control equipment.

originalCode.description: Code used to identify that the control equipment was installed and operational as part of the original unit design.

installDate.description: Approximate date the original control equipment was or will be installed.

optimizationDate.description: The approximate date on which optimization of control equipment was completed and the equipment made fully operational if the control equipment was not part of the original installation.

seasonalControlsIndicator.description: Code used to identify if the NOx control equipment was used during the ozone season.

retireDate.description: Date control equipment was retired. This value will be null for active records.

id.description: Unique identifier of a unit control record.

unitId.description: Unique identifier of a unit record.

userId.description: User account or source of data that added or updated record.

addDate.description: Date and time in which record was added.

updateDate.description: Date and time in which record was last updated.

active.description: Flag for active monitor location record
